correctness.rationale: For any field every three-dimensional subspace H_C is trace-orthogonal to a projective nonzero C. Any nonzero nilpotent 2×2 N has rank one, N=vφ with φ(v)=0; tr(CN)=φ(Cv), vanishing iff Cv lies in span(v). Thus H_C avoids nilpotents iff C has no eigenvalue over F_q, equivalently irreducible characteristic quadratic. Count (q²−q)/2 irreducible quadratics, q(q−1) matrices per polynomial, and identify q−1 scalar multiples to obtain q²(q−1)/2 hyperplanes. Scalar-similarity orbit arguments give q/2 orbits size q(q−1) for even q; odd q has (q−1)/2 trace-normalized orbits of that size plus one trace-zero orbit size q(q−1)/2. Independent exact F3 exhaustive matrix/hyperplane/G-action enumeration found nine good H, orbits [3,6]. Actual source verifier and proof inspected; finite case not taken as universal proof.
